subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Public safety
source.subtopic: Riding trains and taxis safely; dangers of electricity; poisonous and inflammable substances

show.line: Electricity can kill. Never touch wires. In taxis, sit down and wear a seatbelt!

rounds.prompt: A wire is hanging down. What do you do?
When do you get out of a taxi?
Should you fly a kite near power lines?

hints: Electricity and fire are not toys.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A kite is stuck on a power line.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Never climb near power lines.

parent_line: Knows dangers of electricity and how to ride trains and taxis safely.
